(you make money and save them money)

items.title: Niche, Vertical, Industry-specific AI models are coming.
items.summary:
Shopify beat GPT-5.6 with a model it trained in a week.
It had one job... build a profile of what each shopper wants.
Shopify's 0.8B model scored 84.6 on those notes, GPT-5.6 scored 83.0. Source:
Tobi Lutke on X
.
Surprise surprise, Shopify's model went from building 2 million profiles to 72 million A DAY.
Pipecat
ran their own model for support calls. Same quality as GPT, but 1/18th of the cost.
Pipecat's small model scored against the big ones on support calls. Source:
Pipecat's post on X
.
Why do you need the entire history of the world in one model??
It's too heavy.
Trend incoming.. I'm calling it... Niche Language Models...

items.title: Autograph Collectible flipper
items.summary:
Why now
Collectibles values are flying.
The PFC40 Autograph Index is up 825% since 2000.
Source: Paul Fraser Collectibles
A poster signed by one supporting cast member sells for
under $100
. The same poster signed by the whole cast goes for thousands.
The problem: those 5 actors are never in the same room.
The business
You're the network and courier.
You source the half-finished poster in closets
find where each missing name is signing next on
Comic-Con autograph schedule
You flip and split the profit with the owner.
A Batman poster with five cast signatures sold for $2,577.60 in August.

items.title: A YouTuber is the largest shareholder of GoPro now...
items.summary:
Did you see the GoPro thing?
GoPro has been getting smashed in the stock market ( $24 at IPO, 60 cents last week)
Then Markiplier, a gaming YouTuber with ~39 million subscribers,
bought a piece of it
. He wants to make movies on GoPros.
Stock jumped 20%
Creators with distribution are the new private equity.
Attention is the same as a capital injection.
